metaTitle: Custom Rectangular Embroidered Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular embroidered patches for uniforms, events, or branding. Durable and detailed. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular embroidered patches offer a classic, professional look that fits neatly on uniform sleeves, polo chests, or caps. Their straight edges and defined corners make them ideal for logos, name tags, or achievement badges. Choose from a range of sizes and border colors to match your brand. Decorate with up to 12 thread colors for crisp detail. Perfect for corporate teams, safety vests, or event staff identification.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular embroidered patches with colorful thread and iron-on backing on a sleeve
